notes: Fix missing delete/replace controls for image & shape overlays. Each overlay's per-layer controls (image: ↺ Replace / ✕ Remove; shape: layer-order + ✕; video: ✕) live in a nested <details class="layer-accordion"><summary> inside the 'Shapes, Images & Videos' .scene-accordion. The CSS that hides the section header in list and timeline modes used a descendant selector — '.scene-accordion summary { display:none }' — which also matched those nested per-layer summaries and hid every Replace/Remove/✕. So in Scene (list) view you couldn't delete or replace shapes/images at all, and in Timeline view the image Replace was gone (delete still worked there via the Content rail's separate ✕). Scoped both rules to the direct child '.scene-accordion > summary' (header only), and scoped the ▾ disclosure ::after the same way so no stray arrow shows on layer rows. Verified in both views: image Replace+Remove and shape ✕ now render (summary computed display flex, buttons visible).
